description: Composite four-stage workflow figure ("Flow chart of microhardness prediction and design of Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si steel"), each stage in its own dashed rounded box. Top-left, "Data collection and pre-processing": a grid of small sketched crystal/atom icons labelled "Data set" beside a funnel labelled "Importance ranking" with descending spheres Cr > Ni > Mo > "..." (ellipsis). Top-right, "Feature engineering": a four-plot composite — a feature-importance bar chart, a triangular red/blue correlation heatmap, a further bar chart, and a scatter of "Cross-validation scores" (y, 0.0-1.2) versus "Numbers of Features" (x, 1-5); a checklist names the retained descriptors "Difference in cohesive energy δEc", "Local cohesive energy mismatch DEc" and "Shear modulus G". Bottom-left, "Model construction": parity plot of Predicted ΔσSSS (MPa) versus Experimental ΔσSSS (MPa), both axes 1200-1800 MPa, legend "All Samples" (circles coloured by an "Error" colourbar spanning 0.60-29.90) and a dashed "Guide line"; annotations read RMSE:0.31, R²:0.89, "Support vector machine", plus the equation ΔσSSS = Z·M·G·δEc·DEc. Bottom-right, "Inverse design": Microhardness (HV) bar chart for Sample 1-3, blue "Predicted values" versus pink "Experimental values", annotated 521/515 (1.17%), 490/500 (2.00%), 415/424 (2.09%), with the note "The minimum error 1.17%".

observations.observation: The figure is a four-stage flow chart whose stages are labelled Data collection and pre-processing, Feature engineering, Model construction, and Inverse design.
The importance-ranking funnel ranks the elements Cr, Ni, Mo in descending order, ending with an ellipsis sphere that is labelled '...' rather than a named element.
The selected features are printed as 'Difference in cohesive energy δEc', 'Local cohesive energy mismatch DEc' and 'Shear modulus G'.
The model-construction parity plot has axes 'Predicted ΔσSSS (MPa)' and 'Experimental ΔσSSS (MPa)', both spanning 1200 to 1800 MPa.
The parity plot prints RMSE:0.31 and R²:0.89 and labels the regressor as 'Support vector machine'.
The error colourbar next to the parity plot is labelled 'Error' with tick values 0.60, 7.93, 15.25, 22.58 and 29.90.
The equation printed under the parity plot is ΔσSSS = Z·M·G·δEc·DEc.
In the inverse-design bar chart, Sample 1 shows predicted 521 HV versus experimental 515 HV, annotated with 1.17% error.
Sample 2 shows predicted 490 HV versus experimental 500 HV (2.00% error), and Sample 3 shows predicted 415 HV versus experimental 424 HV (2.09% error).
The inverse-design panel carries the statement 'The minimum error 1.17%'.

The 'Numbers of Features' scatter in the feature-engineering panel plots cross-validation scores on a 0.0-1.2 scale; the points for 1 to 4 features sit high on the axis while the point at 5 features lies near the bottom of the axis.
The figure is a schematic workflow of microhardness prediction and design for Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si steel.
The caption identifies no numeric values beyond those printed in the panels; the title is 'Fig. 1. Flow chart of microhardness prediction and design of Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si steel.'

Panel (b) constitutes a composite of four different miniature plots (importance bars, correlation heatmap, a second bar chart, cross-validation scatter), so the group mixes plot types within one stage.

subfigures.description: A 'Data set' block showing a dense grid of small sketched atom/crystal-symbol icons, paired with an 'Importance ranking' funnel in which spheres labelled Cr, Ni, Mo and '...' narrow downwards, implying ranked element importance for the Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si system.

Four small plots: a feature-importance bar chart, a triangular red-to-blue correlation heatmap, an additional bar chart, and a scatter of Cross-validation scores (y-axis 0.0-1.2) against Numbers of Features (x-axis 1-5). A ticked list states the selected features: Difference in cohesive energy δEc, Local cohesive energy mismatch DEc, Shear modulus G. Sub-panel axis labels and titles are only partially legible.

Parity scatter of Predicted ΔσSSS (MPa) versus Experimental ΔσSSS (MPa) with both axes running 1200-1800 MPa, a dashed guide line, points coloured by an Error colourbar (0.60-29.90 with intermediate ticks 7.93, 15.25, 22.58), and printed metrics RMSE:0.31 and R²:0.89 for the Support vector machine model, together with the equation ΔσSSS = Z·M·G·δEc·DEc.

Grouped bar chart of Microhardness (HV) on the y-axis (0-700) for Sample 1, Sample 2 and Sample 3, with blue 'Predicted values' and pink 'Experimental values' bars; printed pairs are 521/515 with 1.17% error, 490/500 with 2.00% error, and 415/424 with 2.09% error, and the caption text 'The minimum error 1.17%'.
